description: Email the user when a product is at a good price (a verified low), or at or under a target price they name. Use after search_catalog/get_product when the user wants to be told when to buy. Ask the user for their email; never invent or reuse one. One watch per email per product; calling again updates the target. The first time an address is used it receives a confirmation email and the watch arms when they click it — tell the user to check their inbox. Each alert links to the product page and carries an unsubscribe link.

email.description: The user's email address, given by the user in this conversation.

slug.description: A slug from search_catalog or get_product.

target_price.description: Optional USD price to alert at or under. Omit to alert on the next verified low.

name: watch_price
title: Watch a price by email
